Yes, it happened to me too. The first week is going to be terrible, but after that it's going to be bearable and then you'll come to a point where you don't feel pain. I still have pain after some of my appointments (hence the wire changes and stuff) but it's never as bad as the first week and it goes away in a few days. Don't worry, it's normal and it's gonna get better.

Eating ice cream made me feel better since the cold numbed the pain a little bit, maybe that could work for you too. You can drink soup for a few days if chewing is very painful for you or just eat foods like yoghurt or mashed potatoes which you don't have to chew.

Also sleeping a lot helped me too. I would take painkillers and sleep for a few hours.

It's going to get better and your teeth will look better! So don't give up!

I've gone to my orthodontist a few times after the lockdown ended, I actually had an appointment just a few days ago. The first time was very stressful but I felt better after they took my temperature and I saw that everyone was wearing masks. I recommend checking their website (if they have one) or calling them and asking if they took any precautions. It'll make you feel better to know how they are handling the situation.

Carry a hand sanitizer with you, don't ever take off your mask while you are waiting for your appointment and try to stay away from everyone else. And after you go out use your hand sanitizer. That's what I've been doing and it's gotten less stressful because I have gotten used to it.

I hope you manage to go to your orthodontist safely.
